Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer states that Quincy Medical Center reopened in late 1999 when James A. Sheets was mayor and closed in December 2014 when Thomas P. Koch was mayor. The Ground Truth Answer states that the mayors were Henry O. Fairbanks (when it opened) and Thomas P. Koch (when it closed). 

The two answers agree on the closing mayor (Thomas P. Koch), but disagree on the opening mayor: the Predicted Answer gives James A. Sheets, while the Ground Truth Answer gives Henry O. Fairbanks. Therefore, the vital fact about the opening mayor from the Ground Truth is missing in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
